raw_problem.problem_text:
$$
V \left(x _ {1}, x _ {2}\right) = - a V _ {0} \delta \left(x _ {1} - x _ {2}\right)
$$

( $\left[ V _ { 0 } \right]$ 同为有能量量纲的一个常数， $a$ 为势阱宽度).

(a) 首先，忽略粒子间的相互作用，求基态和第一激发态的波函数和相应的能量.  
(b) 利用一阶微扰理论估算粒子间相互作用对基态和第一激发态能量的影响.
raw_problem.solution_text:
时基态和第一激发态的波函数分别为(不考虑粒子的自旋)

$$
\psi_ {1 1} ^ {0} = \frac {2}{a} \sin \left(\frac {\pi x _ {1}}{a}\right) \sin \left(\frac {\pi x _ {2}}{a}\right),
$$

$$
E _ {1 1} ^ {0} = \frac {\pi^ {2} \hbar^ {2}}{m a ^ {2}},
$$

$$
\psi_ {1 2} ^ {0} = \frac {\sqrt {2}}{a} \left[ \sin \left(\frac {\pi x _ {1}}{a}\right) \sin \left(\frac {2 \pi x _ {2}}{a}\right) + \sin \left(\frac {2 \pi x _ {1}}{a}\right) \sin \left(\frac {\pi x _ {2}}{a}\right) \right],
$$

$$
E _ {1 2} ^ {0} = \frac {5 \pi^ {2} \hbar^ {2}}{2 m a ^ {2}}.
$$

以上两个能级都是非简并的.

(b) 按照一阶微扰理论，

$$
\begin{array}{l} E _ {1 1} ^ {\prime} = \left\langle \psi_ {1 1} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {1 1} ^ {0} \right\rangle \\ = - 4 \frac {V _ {0}}{a} \int_ {0} ^ {a} \int_ {0} ^ {a} \sin \left(\frac {\pi x _ {1}}{a}\right) \sin \left(\frac {\pi x _ {2}}{a}\right) \delta (x _ {1} - x _ {2}) \sin \left(\frac {\pi x _ {1}}{a}\right) \sin \left(\frac {\pi x _ {2}}{a}\right) \mathrm {d} x _ {1} \mathrm {d} x _ {2} \\ = - 4 \frac {V _ {0}}{a} \int_ {0} ^ {a} \sin^ {4} \left(\frac {\pi x _ {2}}{a}\right) \mathrm {d} x _ {2} \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} = - \frac {3}{2} V _ {0}. \\ E _ {1 2} ^ {\prime} = \left\langle \psi_ {1 2} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {1 2} ^ {0} \right\rangle \\ = - 2 \frac {V _ {0}}{a} \int_ {0} ^ {a} \int_ {0} ^ {a} \left[ \sin \left(\frac {\pi x _ {1}}{a}\right) \sin \left(\frac {2 \pi x _ {2}}{a}\right) \right. \\ \left. + \sin \left(\frac {2 \pi x _ {1}}{a}\right) \sin \left(\frac {\pi x _ {2}}{a}\right) \right] ^ {2} \delta \left(x _ {1} - x _ {2}\right) d x _ {1} d x _ {2} \\ = - 2 \frac {V _ {0}}{a} \int_ {0} ^ {a} \left[ \sin \left(\frac {\pi x _ {1}}{a}\right) \sin \left(\frac {2 \pi x _ {1}}{a}\right) + \sin \left(\frac {2 \pi x _ {1}}{a}\right) \sin \left(\frac {\pi x _ {1}}{a}\right) \right] ^ {2} d x _ {1} \\ = - 8 \frac {V _ {0}}{a} \int_ {0} ^ {a} \sin^ {2} \left(\frac {\pi x _ {1}}{a}\right) \sin^ {2} \left(\frac {2 \pi x _ {1}}{a}\right) d x _ {1} \\ = - 2 V _ {0}. \\ \end{array}
$$

**习题 7.4 将微扰理论应用于最具代表性的二能级系统.系统未微扰的哈密顿量为

$$
\boldsymbol {\mathcal {H}} ^ {0} = \left( \begin{array}{c c} E _ {a} ^ {0} & 0 \\ 0 & E _ {b} ^ {0} \end{array} \right),
$$

微扰项为

$$
\boldsymbol {\mathcal {H}} ^ {\prime} = \lambda \left( \begin{array}{c c} V _ {a a} & V _ {a b} \\ V _ {b a} & V _ {b b} \end{array} \right),
$$

其中 $V _ { b a } = V _ { a b } ^ { * } , V _ { a a }$ $V _ { a a }$ 和 $V _ { b b }$ 为实数，因此 $\varkappa$ 是厄米矩阵，如 7. 1. 节所述， $\lambda$ 是一常量，将在后面设置为1.

(a) 求该二能级系统的精确能量.   
(b) (a) 中的结果展开到 $\lambda$ 的二阶项(然后设 $\lambda$ 1). 验证展开项与 7. 1.节和 7.1. 节中微扰理论的结果一致.假设 $E _ { b } > E _ { a }$ .  
(c) 设 $V _ { a a } = V _ { b b } = 0$ 证明: (b) 中的展开项仅 $\left| \frac { V _ { a b } } { E _ { b } ^ { 0 } - E _ { a } ^ { 0 } } \right| < \frac { 1 } { 2 }$ 条件下收敛

注释一般来说，只有当微扰矩阵元比能级之间间隔小很多时，微扰理论才成立.否则，前几项(这全部是我们曾经计算过的)将会对我们感兴趣的物理量给出很差的近似，并且，如这里所示，展开项可能无法收敛，在这种情况下，前几项不能提供有价值的信息.

解答 (a)

$$
\boldsymbol {\mathcal {H}} = \boldsymbol {\mathcal {H}} ^ {0} + \boldsymbol {\mathcal {H}} ^ {\prime} = \left[ \begin{array}{c c} E _ {a} ^ {0} + \lambda V _ {a a} & \lambda V _ {a b} \\ \lambda V _ {b a} & E _ {b} ^ {0} + \lambda V _ {b b} \end{array} \right] = \left[ \begin{array}{c c} A & \lambda V _ {a b} \\ \lambda V _ {b a} & B \end{array} \right],
$$

其中 $A = E _ { a } ^ { 0 } + \lambda V _ { a a } , B = E _ { b } ^ { 0 } + \lambda V _ { b b }$

由

$$
\left[ \begin{array}{c c} A & \lambda V _ {a b} \\ \lambda V _ {b a} & B \end{array} \right] \left[ \begin{array}{c} \psi_ {+} \\ \psi_ {-} \end{array} \right] = E \left[ \begin{array}{c} \psi_ {+} \\ \psi_ {-} \end{array} \right],
$$

得久期方程

$$
\left| \begin{array}{c c} A - E & \lambda V _ {a b} \\ \lambda V _ {b a} & B - E \end{array} \right| = 0,
$$

$$
E ^ {2} - (A + B) E + A B - \lambda^ {2} | V _ {a b} | ^ {2} = 0,
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} E _ {\pm} = \frac {(A + B) \pm \sqrt {(A + B) ^ {2} - 4 (A B - \lambda^ {2} | V _ {a b} | ^ {2})}}{2} \\ = \frac {(A + B) \pm \sqrt {(A - B) ^ {2} + 4 \lambda^ {2} | V _ {a b} | ^ {2}}}{2}. \\ \end{array}
$$

(b) (a)

$$
\begin{array}{l} E _ {\pm} = \frac {(A + B) \pm \sqrt {(A - B) ^ {2} + 4 \lambda^ {2} | V _ {a b} | ^ {2}}}{2} \\ = \frac {(A + B) \pm (B - A) \sqrt {1 + \frac {4 \lambda^ {2} | V _ {a b} | ^ {2}}{(B - A) ^ {2}}}}{2}, \\ \end{array}
$$

结合

$$
\sqrt {1 + \frac {4 \lambda^ {2} \left| V _ {a b} \right| ^ {2}}{(B - A) ^ {2}}} \approx 1 + \frac {1}{2} \frac {4 \lambda^ {2} \left| V _ {a b} \right| ^ {2}}{(B - A) ^ {2}},
$$

可得

$$
\begin{array}{l} E _ {\pm} = \frac {1}{2} \left\{\left(A + B\right) \pm (B - A) \left[ 1 + \frac {2 \lambda^ {2} \left| V _ {a b} \right| ^ {2}}{(B - A) ^ {2}} \right] \right\} \\ = \frac {1}{2} \left\{\left(A + B\right) \pm \left[ \left(B - A\right) + \frac {2 \lambda^ {2} \left| V _ {a b} \right| ^ {2}}{(B - A)} \right] \right\} \\ = \frac {1}{2} \left\{\left(E _ {a} ^ {0} + \lambda V _ {a a} + E _ {b} ^ {0} + \lambda V _ {b b}\right) \right. \\ \left. \pm \left[ \left(E _ {b} ^ {0} + \lambda V _ {b b} - E _ {a} ^ {0} - \lambda V _ {a a}\right) + \frac {2 \lambda^ {2} | V _ {a b} | ^ {2}}{\left(E _ {b} ^ {0} + \lambda V _ {b b} - E _ {a} ^ {0} - \lambda V _ {a a}\right)} \right] \right\} \\ \approx \frac {1}{2} \left\{\left(E _ {a} ^ {0} + E _ {b} ^ {0}\right) + \lambda \left(V _ {a a} + V _ {b b}\right) \right. \\ \left. \pm \left[ \left(E _ {b} ^ {0} - E _ {a} ^ {0}\right) + \lambda \left(V _ {b b} - V _ {a a}\right) + \frac {2 \lambda^ {2} \left| V _ {a b} \right| ^ {2}}{E _ {b} ^ {0} - E _ {a} ^ {0}} \right] \right\}. \\ \end{array}
$$

所以，

$$
\begin{array}{l} E _ {+} = \frac {1}{2} \left\{\left(E _ {a} ^ {0} + E _ {b} ^ {0}\right) + \lambda \left(V _ {a a} + V _ {b b}\right) + \left[ \left(E _ {b} ^ {0} - E _ {a} ^ {0}\right) + \lambda \left(V _ {b b} - V _ {a a}\right) + \frac {2 \lambda^ {2} \left| V _ {a b} \right| ^ {2}}{E _ {b} ^ {0} - E _ {a} ^ {0}} \right] \right\} \\ = \frac {1}{2} \left[ 2 E _ {b} ^ {0} + 2 \lambda V _ {b b} + \frac {2 \lambda^ {2} | V _ {a b} | ^ {2}}{E _ {b} ^ {0} - E _ {a} ^ {0}} \right] = E _ {b} ^ {0} + \lambda V _ {b b} + \frac {\lambda^ {2} | V _ {a b} | ^ {2}}{E _ {b} ^ {0} - E _ {a} ^ {0}}. \\ \end{array}
$$

同样地 $E _ { - } = E _ { a } ^ { 0 } + \lambda V _ { a a } - \frac { \lambda ^ { 2 } \left| V _ { a b } \right| ^ { 2 } } { E _ { b } ^ { 0 } - E _ { a } ^ { 0 } }$

$\lambda = 1$ $E _ { + } = E _ { b } ^ { 0 } + V _ { b b } + \frac { \left| V _ { a b } \right| ^ { 2 } } { E _ { b } ^ { 0 } - E _ { a } ^ { 0 } }$ E-=E2+ ' -"'- - -"'a -, 凡一」旦 r"" - Ef - Eg'

对比一阶微拢的结果，

$$
E _ {a} ^ {1} = \left\langle \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right\rangle = (1 0) \left( \begin{array}{c c} V _ {a a} & V _ {a b} \\ V _ {b a} & V _ {b b} \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} 1 \\ 0 \end{array} \right) = V _ {a a},
$$

$$
E _ {b} ^ {1} = \left\langle \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right\rangle = (0 1) \left( \begin{array}{c c} V _ {a a} & V _ {a b} \\ V _ {b a} & V _ {b b} \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} 0 \\ 1 \end{array} \right) = V _ {b b},
$$

这与直接求解中的第二项一致.

对比二阶微拢的结果，由

$$
\left\langle \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right\rangle = (0 1) \left( \begin{array}{c c} V _ {a a} & V _ {a b} \\ V _ {b a} & V _ {b b} \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} 1 \\ 0 \end{array} \right) = V _ {b a},
$$

$$
\left\langle \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right\rangle = (1 0) \left( \begin{array}{c c} V _ {a a} & V _ {a b} \\ V _ {b a} & V _ {b b} \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} 0 \\ 1 \end{array} \right) = V _ {a b},
$$

所以，

$$
E _ {a} ^ {2} = \frac {\left| \left\langle \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right\rangle \right| ^ {2}}{E _ {a} ^ {0} - E _ {b} ^ {0}} = - \frac {\left| V _ {a b} \right| ^ {2}}{E _ {b} ^ {0} - E _ {a} ^ {0}},
$$

$$
E _ {b} ^ {2} = \frac {\left| \left\langle \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right\rangle \right| ^ {2}}{E _ {b} ^ {0} - E _ {a} ^ {0}} = \frac {| V _ {a b} | ^ {2}}{E _ {b} ^ {0} - E _ {a} ^ {0}}.
$$

这与直接求解中的第三项一致.

(。在 (a) 求解过程中将 $\sqrt { 1 + \frac { 4 \left| V _ { a b } \right| ^ { 2 } } { \left( E _ { b } ^ { 0 } - E _ { a } ^ { 0 } \right) ^ { 2 } } }$ 浙琼勒展开，并在第 疵进行截断，这需 $\frac { 4 \left| V _ { a b } \right| ^ { 2 } } { \left( E _ { b } ^ { 0 } - E _ { a } ^ { 0 } \right) ^ { 2 } }$ 是个小量，以保证最终的解在取很少的展开项时收敛

因此, $\frac { 4 \left| V _ { a b } \right| ^ { 2 } } { \left( E _ { b } ^ { 0 } - E _ { a } ^ { 0 } \right) ^ { 2 } } < 1$ < ，即 $\frac { | V _ { a b } | } { E _ { b } ^ { 0 } - E _ { a } ^ { 0 } } < \frac { 1 } { 2 }$

# *习题 7.5

(a) 求出习题 7.1 中势的能量二阶修正 $\left( E _ { n } ^ { 2 } \right)$ 注释可以直接对级数求和，当$n$ 为奇数时，结果为 $- 2 m \left( \alpha / \pi \hbar n \right) ^ { 2 }$ .  
(b) 对习题 7.2 中的作用势，计算基态能量的二阶修正( $\left( E _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } \right)$ .验证所得结果和精确解一致.

解答能量二阶修正公式为

$$
E _ {n} ^ {2} = \sum_ {k \neq n} \frac {\left| \left\langle \psi_ {\mathrm {k}} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {n} ^ {0} \right\rangle \right| ^ {2}}{E _ {n} ^ {0} - E _ {k} ^ {0}}.
$$

(a) 对习题 7.1 中的无限深方势阱和微扰势 $H ^ { \prime } = \alpha \delta \left( x - a / 2 \right)$ ，有

$$
\begin{array}{l} \left\langle \psi_ {k} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {n} ^ {0} \right\rangle = \frac {2}{a} \alpha \int_ {0} ^ {a} \sin \left(\frac {k}{a} \pi x\right) \delta \left(x - \frac {a}{2}\right) \sin \left(\frac {n}{a} \pi x\right) d x \\ = \frac {2 \alpha}{a} \sin \left(\frac {k}{2} \pi\right) \sin \left(\frac {n}{2} \pi\right), \\ E _ {n} ^ {0} - E _ {k} ^ {0} = \frac {\left(n ^ {2} - k ^ {2}\right) \pi^ {2} \hbar^ {2}}{2 m a ^ {2}}. \\ \end{array}
$$

具有当 $k$ 和 $n$ 都为奇数时，矩阵元才不为 ，所以

$$
\begin{array}{l} E _ {n} ^ {2} = \sum_ {k \neq n} \frac {\left| \left\langle \psi_ {\mathrm {k}} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {n} ^ {0} \right\rangle \right| ^ {2}}{E _ {n} ^ {0} - E _ {k} ^ {0}} = \sum_ {k \neq n \text {且 为 奇 数}} \frac {4 \alpha^ {2} / a ^ {2}}{\left(n ^ {2} - k ^ {2}\right) \pi^ {2} \hbar^ {2} / 2 m a ^ {2}} \\ = \frac {8 m \alpha^ {2}}{\pi^ {2} \hbar^ {2}} \cdot \frac {1}{2 n} \sum_ {\substack {k \neq n \text{且为奇数}}} \left(\frac {1}{k + n} - \frac {1}{k - n}\right). \\ \end{array}
$$

当 $n = 1$ 时，

$$
\sum_ {k = 3, 5, 7, \dots} \left(\frac {1}{k + 1} - \frac {1}{k - 1}\right) = \frac {1}{4} + \frac {1}{6} + \frac {1}{8} + \dots - \frac {1}{2} - \frac {1}{4} - \frac {1}{6} - \dots = - \frac {1}{2}.
$$

当 $n = 3$ 时,

$$
\sum_ {k = 1, 5, 7, \dots} \left(\frac {1}{k + 3} - \frac {1}{k - 3}\right) = \frac {1}{4} + \frac {1}{8} + \frac {1}{1 0} \dots + \frac {1}{2} - \frac {1}{2} - \frac {1}{4} - \frac {1}{6} - \frac {1}{8} - \dots = - \frac {1}{6}.
$$

推广到一般情况，级数除了 $- { \frac { 1 } { 2 n } }$ 项无法抵消外，其余均可以相互抵消掉，所以

$$
E _ {n} ^ {2} = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 0 & (n \text {为 偶 数}) \\ \frac {8 m \alpha^ {2}}{\pi^ {2} \hbar^ {2}} \cdot \frac {1}{4 n ^ {2}} = - 2 m \frac {\alpha}{\pi \hbar n ^ {2}} & (n \text {为 奇 数}) \end{array} \right..
$$

(b) 利用产生与温灭算符，

$$
x = \sqrt {\frac {\hbar}{2 m \omega}} (a _ {+} + a _ {-}), \quad a _ {+} \psi_ {n} = \sqrt {n + 1} \psi_ {n + 1}, \quad a _ {-} \psi_ {n} = \sqrt {n} \psi_ {n - 1}.
$$

$$
H ^ {\prime} = \frac {1}{2} \varepsilon k x ^ {2} = \frac {\hbar \varepsilon k}{4 m \omega} \left(a _ {+} ^ {2} + a _ {+} a _ {-} + a _ {-} a _ {+} + a _ {-} ^ {2}\right) = \frac {\hbar \varepsilon \omega}{4} \left(a _ {+} ^ {2} + a _ {+} a _ {-} + a _ {-} a _ {+} + a _ {-} ^ {2}\right).
$$

$$
E _ {n} ^ {2} = \sum_ {l \neq n} \frac {\left| \left\langle \psi_ {l} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {n} ^ {0} \right\rangle \right| ^ {2}}{E _ {n} ^ {0} - E _ {l} ^ {0}} = \frac {\hbar^ {2} \varepsilon^ {2} \omega^ {2}}{1 6} \sum_ {l \neq n} \frac {\left| \left\langle \psi_ {l} ^ {0} \right| a _ {+} ^ {2} + a _ {+} a _ {-} + a _ {-} a + a _ {-} ^ {2} \left| \psi_ {n} ^ {0} \right\rangle \right| ^ {2}}{\hbar \omega (n - l)}.
$$

由于 $l \neq n$ 故有

$$
\begin{array}{l} E _ {n} ^ {2} = \frac {\varepsilon^ {2} \hbar \omega}{1 6} \sum_ {l \neq n} \frac {\left| \left\langle \psi_ {l} ^ {0} \right| a _ {+} ^ {2} \left| \psi_ {n} ^ {0} \right\rangle + \left\langle \psi_ {l} ^ {0} \right| a _ {-} ^ {2} \left| \psi_ {n} ^ {0} \right\rangle \right| ^ {2}}{n - l} \\ = \frac {\varepsilon^ {2} \hbar \omega}{1 6} \cdot \sum_ {l \neq n} \frac {\left| \sqrt {(n + 1) (n + 2)} \delta_ {l , n + 2} + \sqrt {n (n - 1)} \delta_ {l , n - 2} \right| ^ {2}}{n - l} \\ = \frac {\varepsilon^ {2} \hbar \omega}{1 6} \left[ \frac {- (n + 1) (n + 2)}{2} + \frac {n (n - 1)}{2} \right] = - \frac {\varepsilon^ {2} \hbar \omega}{8} \left(n + \frac {1}{2}\right) \\ = - \frac {\varepsilon^ {2}}{8} E _ {n} ^ {0}. \\ \end{array}
$$

这与习题 中的结果是一致的.

串串习题 7.6 考虑位于一维谐振子势场中的带电粒子. 假设加上一个微弱的电场$( E )$ ， 从而使势能产生了 $H ^ { \prime } = - q E x$ 的偏移.

(a) 证明:能量一阶修正为军，并计算出能量的二阶修正.提示 参考习题 3.39.

(b) 只要将变量变成 $x ^ { \prime } \equiv x - q E / ( m \omega ^ { 2 } )$ ，本题就可以直接求解薛定博方程.求出能量的精确值，并证明它们和微扰理论的近似结果是一致的.

解答 (a) 利用升降阶算符，能量的一阶修正为

$$
E _ {n} ^ {1} = \left\langle \psi_ {n} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {n} ^ {0} \right\rangle = - q E \left\langle \psi_ {n} ^ {0} \right| x \left| \psi_ {n} ^ {0} \right\rangle = - q E \sqrt {\frac {\hbar}{2 m \omega}} \left\langle \psi_ {n} ^ {0} \right| a _ {+} + a _ {-} \left| \psi_ {n} ^ {0} \right\rangle = 0.
$$

能量的工阶修正为

$$
\begin{array}{l} E _ {n} ^ {2} = \sum_ {k \neq n} \frac {\left| \left\langle \psi_ {k} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {n} ^ {0} \right\rangle \right| ^ {2}}{E _ {n} ^ {0} - E _ {\mathrm {k}} ^ {0}} \\ = \frac {E ^ {2} q ^ {2}}{\hbar \omega} \sum_ {k \neq n} \frac {\left| \left\langle \psi_ {k} ^ {0} \right| x \left| \psi_ {n} ^ {0} \right\rangle \right| ^ {2}}{n - k} \\ = \frac {E ^ {2} q ^ {2}}{2 m \omega^ {2}} \sum_ {k \neq n} \frac {\left| \left\langle \psi_ {k} ^ {0} \right| a _ {+} + a _ {-} \left| \psi_ {n} ^ {0} \right\rangle \right| ^ {2}}{n - k} \\ = \frac {E ^ {2} q ^ {2}}{2 m \omega^ {2}} \sum_ {k \neq n} \frac {\left| \sqrt {n + 1} \delta_ {k , n + 1} + \sqrt {n} \delta_ {k , n - 1} \right| ^ {2}}{n - k} \\ = \frac {E ^ {2} q ^ {2}}{2 m \omega^ {2}} \left[ \frac {\left| \sqrt {n + 1} \right| ^ {2}}{n - (n + 1)} + \frac {\left| \sqrt {n} \right| ^ {2}}{n - (n - 1)} \right] \\ = - \frac {E ^ {2} q ^ {2}}{2 m \omega^ {2}}. \\ \end{array}
$$

定态薛定诲方程为

$$
- \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \frac {\mathrm {d} ^ {2} \psi}{\mathrm {d} x ^ {2}} + \left(\frac {1}{2} m \omega^ {2} x ^ {2} - E q x\right) \psi = E \psi .
$$

作变量代换 $x ^ { \prime } = x - { \frac { E q } { m \omega ^ { 2 } } }$ 得mw~

$$
- \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \frac {\mathrm {d} ^ {2} \psi}{\mathrm {d} x ^ {\prime 2}} + \frac {1}{2} m \omega^ {2} x ^ {\prime 2} \psi = \left(E + \frac {E ^ {2} q ^ {2}}{2 m \omega^ {2}}\right) \psi ,
$$

可以得到能量的精确解为
